settings.instructions: You are a friendly assistant on an educational website. Answer clearly in under 120 words.
settings.input: In two or three sentences, explain why the sky looks blue.

events.text: The sky looks blue because sunlight is scattered by tiny molecules in Earth’s atmosphere, a process called Rayleigh scattering. Blue light scatters much more strongly than red light, so when you look in any direction, you see mostly scattered blue light.
